profile.notOfficial: No number in this profile is taken from, or claims to be, the standard of any examination board.

FOUNDATIONAL.targetCognitiveDemand: apply one known procedure to a directly stated situation
FOUNDATIONAL.algebraicComplexity: one relation, coefficients given or read directly

STANDARD.targetCognitiveDemand: choose and carry out a procedure of several steps; read a result back
STANDARD.algebraicComplexity: one relation the learner sets up or rearranges

CHALLENGE.targetCognitiveDemand: plan a solution that is not signposted; connect two ideas or representations; justify
numberTypes: values that must be chosen or bounded
CHALLENGE.algebraicComplexity: a relation with a parameter, a constraint or two linked relations

distractorSophistication.FOUNDATIONAL: each distractor is the result of one named single error
distractorSophistication.STANDARD: each distractor is the result of a named error at a different step; no distractor is eliminable by magnitude alone
distractorSophistication.CHALLENGE: at least two distractors are the result of a correct method applied to a plausible misreading or of stopping one step early; none is eliminable without working

NUMERIC_ENTRY.expectedResponseDepth: one number in a stated form (unit, rounding)

expectedResponseDepth.FOUNDATIONAL: working of one or two lines
expectedResponseDepth.CHALLENGE: a justified argument: a REASONING mark point is required

PROCEDURAL: an unknown constant to be determined from a condition
a result to be interpreted or checked against a constraint
a reverse problem (the usual answer is given, a given is asked)
MODELLING: a constraint that makes the unconstrained optimum inadmissible
a model to be chosen between two candidates
a parameter whose effect must be explained
REASONING: a claim that is true for one reading of the data and false for another
a comparison that reverses when a base rate is used
an argument to be completed or criticised
DATA_INTERPRETATION: a quantity not tabulated that must be derived from two rows
a change of base between two questions
a judgement of whether the data suffice
